article:
The library support:
Shape nodes (Line, Rectangle, Polygon, Polyline, Arc, Circle, Ellipse, QuadCruce, CubicCurcve, path, SVGPath)
Region nodes, including Controls
ImageView nodes
Group nodes
Shape3D nodes (by converting them to images)
The following elements are also supported:
Clips are supported
LinearGradients are supported
ImagePatterns are supported
The following effects are supported: DropShadow, GaussianBlur
RadialGradients support is incomplete
Lighting support is incomplete
Many effects are not supported
Animations are not supported for the moment
